label: Photography Style
description: Professional photographic disciplines with their lighting, lens and craft conventions.

items.text: editorial photography style, considered styling, clean negative space left for type, the narrative polish of a magazine feature

items.text: high-fashion campaign photography, bold art direction, hard direct flash against seamless color, graphic angular poses

items.name: documentary
items.text: documentary photography, unposed truthful moments, available light only, honest grain and imperfect framing that proves presence

items.name: street
items.text: street photography, decisive candid moments, zone-focused wide-lens closeness, layered strangers against hard urban geometry

items.name: fine-art
items.text: fine-art photography, deliberate concept, long tonal range of a gallery print, quiet formal composition and generous negative space

items.name: product-commercial
items.text: commercial product photography, flawless swept surfaces, gradient reflections shaped with scrims and flags, premium sheen

items.name: food-editorial
items.text: editorial food photography, raking directional soft light carving texture, styled crumbs and rising steam, shallow tabletop depth

items.name: architectural
items.text: architectural photography, verticals corrected with a shifted lens, patient light at the day's edges, material honesty in stone and glass

items.name: sports-action
items.text: sports action photography, peak-moment timing frozen by a fast shutter, tight telephoto isolation, background compressed to pure color

items.name: wildlife-documentary
items.text: wildlife documentary photography, patient telephoto fieldcraft at first light, eye-level with the animal, natural unaware behavior

items.name: boudoir-artistic
items.text: artistic boudoir photography, tasteful intimate elegance, soft window key with deep falloff, grace implied rather than shown

items.name: beauty-closeup
items.text: beauty photography, tight close crop, wraparound clamshell lighting, immaculate skin texture with visible pores, saturated lip color

items.name: lifestyle
items.text: lifestyle photography, sun-flared candid warmth, believable in-between moments, airy natural grade with soft highlights

items.name: macro
items.text: macro photography, life-size 1:1 magnification, a razor-thin focal plane dissolving into creamy blur, micro-texture resolved beyond what the eye sees

items.name: underwater
items.text: underwater photography, cyan depth haze, sunbeams shafting down from the surface, suspended particulate glittering in the light

items.name: astro-landscape
items.text: astro-landscape photography, the Milky Way core arching over a dark foreground, long-exposure star detail, faint green airglow on the horizon
